fields.notes: ETG Brochure is a protocol-level document; silicon DFT is vendor-specific. The diagnostic facilities listed above are wire-protocol-visible and the primary observability mechanism in deployed systems.
internal_diagnostics_observability: BRD 0x0130 sweep snapshots ESM state of every SubDevice.
Independent Diagnostic Interface — external tool read-only via MainDevice pass-through.
out_of_band_test_facilities: External crystal/oscillator replaceable for compliance characterization.
Conformance Test Tool (CTT) — ETG-provided official suite.
fields.esc_silicon_dft: Implementation-specific to ESC ASIC vendor. Beckhoff ET1100 includes full JTAG boundary scan (IEEE 1149.1), at-speed BIST of on-the-fly engine memory, scan chains. FPGA-based ESC IP cores rely on FPGA fabric's native DFT.

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
